requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

The specification occupies one page and explicitly records the physical construction, numeric column count, margin measurements, type sizes, identifiable font names and readable labels distinguishing Mara from Ivo. It states the alternating first-reading route, both character rereading routes beginning after I3, and the restriction that the resolution first appears in M3. Design choices may vary, but placeholders, unspecified measurements or missing reading rules fail.

The stated edition is a perfect-bound paperback with 120 × 160 mm trim and 176 interior pages, yielding 88 leaves. Its uncoated cream stock is 80 gsm Munken Print Cream 15 with 0.12 mm sheet thickness, and the calculation yields a 10.56 mm spine. Equivalent unit notation is acceptable. Treating the 22 sample positions as the edition extent, using a 6 mm spine or giving inconsistent arithmetic fails.

Read the wrap's labels and inspect its geometry: the left-to-right panels are a 120 mm back, 10.56 mm spine and 120 mm front, forming a 250.56 × 160 mm trimmed wrap with 3 mm bleed around the exterior. Both front views show the complete title THE SECOND BELL; the spine repeats it in a top-to-bottom reading direction. The back prints the full blurb: One cinema. Two voices. One last night. A locked door, an empty case and a familiar sound leave Mara and Ivo listening for different answers. Line wrapping may vary, but missing or changed words fail. The thumbnail retains the front's 120:160 proportions and a legible, uncropped title at its intended reduced display size; exact raster dimensions are not assessed.

The annotation area visibly states 120 × 160 mm trim, 176 interior pages and a 10.56 mm spine, agreeing with the specification. These may be arranged as labels, a table or a diagram. A value appearing only in the source specification, being unreadable on the wrap or contradicting the edition fails.

The presentation explicitly repeats the 120 × 160 mm trim, 176-page interior extent and 10.56 mm spine, together with the column count, margin measurements, type sizes and actual font names selected in the specification. Legible reproduction of the specification can supply this evidence. Missing values, substituted fonts or contradictory measurements fail.

The document contains six pages: entry/contents at sample folios 2–3, Mara's voice introduction at 4–5 and Ivo's at 6–7. Names and readable viewpoint labels identify both voices. Contents list M1 8, I1 10, M2 12, I2 14, M3 16 and I3 18, and establish that order as the first reading. Entry and Mara's opener lead to M1 page 8; Ivo's opener leads to I1 page 10. Arrangement and introductory wording may vary; missing introductions, misallocated folios, incorrect destinations or an ambiguous first route fail.

Read every spread against its assigned manuscript in 01-client-facts.en.md. Each contains all three body paragraphs in order, without substitution, omission, duplication or transfer to another spread. Required records are: M1, Mara, 22:10, Light under the door, folios 8–9, Next I1 page 10; I1, Ivo, 22:10, A place to put the rain, 10–11, Next M2 page 12; M2, Mara, 22:26, The empty circle, 12–13, Next I2 page 14; I2, Ivo, 22:26, The missing word, 14–15, Next M3 page 16; M3, Mara, 22:40, After the second bell, 16–17, Next I3 page 18; I3, Ivo, 22:40, The label I could finish, 18–19, Reread pages 20–21. Metadata must remain distinguishable from body paragraphs. Quotation-mark styling, line breaks and discretionary hyphenation may vary while preserving wording and meaning; unreadable text or incorrect records fail.

Compare all six spreads with the specified columns, margins, type hierarchy, font choices and viewpoint labels. Mara and Ivo remain identifiable through the declared system, and each spread visibly implements the applicable layout rules. Voice-specific treatments and exceptions explicitly defined in the specification are allowed. Unexplained changes of grid, hierarchy, fonts or viewpoint labelling fail; exact font metrics are not inferred from raster pixels.

Assess text, captions and imagery using the attachment's narrative information stages. Cover imagery remains abstract or ambiguous within the opening premise; each early story uses only information available by its own stage, and the mockup uses the cover and M1. No early image exposes the mother's instruction, repaired leader, childhood film or explicit conclusion that nothing was stolen. M3 introduces those facts, while I3 and the map develop their consequences and retrospective connections. Earlier ambiguous motifs are allowed; explicit or unmistakable premature resolution imagery fails.

Inspect all six opening pages, including introductions, captions and illustrations. Reader-facing exposition stays within the cinema's closing night, two voices, locked door, empty case and familiar sound. Required contents IDs and exact chapter headings are allowed. Explanatory copy or imagery revealing the mother's instruction, repaired film leader, childhood film or innocence resolution fails.

The spread bears folios 20–21 and the heading Reread. It explicitly places both character routes after I3: Mara M1 8 → M2 12 → M3 16 and Ivo I1 10 → I2 14 → I3 18. It visibly connects M1/I1 with 22:10, M2/I2 with 22:26 and M3/I3 with 22:40. A diagram, table or other readable arrangement is acceptable. Missing destinations, incorrect pairings or presenting these routes as the initial reading fails.

One composition shows a closed perfect-bound paperback and an open copy displaying M1. The closed front visibly carries THE SECOND BELL and matches the delivered cover's artwork and typography; the open spread matches the delivered M1 layout, heading and content. The book's apparent trim proportions and spine are compatible with the 120 × 160 mm, 10.56 mm-spine edition. Perspective, lighting and natural page curvature are allowed. A different cover, substitute spread, implausibly thin booklet or altered M1 content fails.

Review the complete video and its duration. It runs for 10 seconds, subject only to frame-rounding tolerance, and visibly features the delivered cover and M1. Visible front covers carry the complete title THE SECOND BELL. Motion, transitions and perspective may vary while retaining those designs. Any captions, narration or added imagery stay within the cover and M1 information stages. A substitute design, absent M1, materially different duration or disclosure of the M3 resolution fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation has at least eight pages and visibly incorporates identifiable material from every listed source, including both cover views and each of the six story spreads. Scaling, explanatory crops and grouped layouts are allowed when source identity remains clear. Merely naming a deliverable, replacing it with a generic illustration or omitting a source fails.

The presentation explains that 22 positions comprise cover positions 1 and 22 plus interior sample folios 2–21 within a 176-page novel. Using the delivered pages, it demonstrates M1 → I1 → M2 → I2 → M3 → I3, Mara's M1 → M2 → M3 reread and Ivo's I1 → I2 → I3 reread after I3. It shows how I2 leads into M3 and explains the change from uncertainty to the mother's instruction, repaired leader, childhood film and conclusion that nothing was stolen. Process discussion may disclose the full resolution. Confusing sample extent with edition extent, missing a route or offering only generic commentary without the relevant pages fails.
Record whether the optional subtitle A story in two voices is used. Omitting it is an expressly permitted design choice and does not reduce the score.
Treat the supplied bookstore image as an atmospheric reference. It does not establish an object identity anchor or require an exact reconstruction of its table, furnishings or surrounding books.
